questions.label: Found a wallet
questions.prompt: You find a wallet on the sidewalk with cash and an ID inside.

options.label: Track down the owner and return it
Drop it at the nearest shop counter, leave a note
Hand it to the police station on the next block
Leave it where it is; someone will come back

questions.label: Stranger needs help
questions.prompt: A stranger at a coffee shop looks lost and asks for directions.

options.label: Walk them to the right bus stop
Pull up a map on your phone and explain
Give them quick verbal directions and wish them luck
Point them to a staff member who knows the area

questions.label: Team disagreement
questions.prompt: Your team is split on a decision. The deadline is tomorrow.

options.label: Call a short meeting and force a call today
Take a quick vote and move on
Spend an hour researching the right answer
Defer to whoever has the most experience

questions.label: Lost dog
questions.prompt: A neighbor's dog is loose and heading toward a busy road.

options.label: Run after it, don't stop until it's safe
Call the dog by name and use treats if you have any
Position yourself to block its path calmly
Knock on the neighbor's door first

questions.label: Friend asks for money
questions.prompt: A friend asks to borrow a meaningful amount of money.

options.label: Yes, on the spot, no questions
Yes, but ask what it's for first
Propose a clear repayment plan before saying yes
Politely say no, explain you can't right now

questions.label: New hobby
questions.prompt: You see a class for something you've always wanted to try.

options.label: Sign up today, no hesitation
Research the teacher, the price, the time
Watch a free intro class first, then decide
Save the link for later

questions.label: Big news headline
questions.prompt: A big news story drops. Your first move?

options.label: Share it with a friend who cares about the topic
Read multiple sources before saying anything
Take action — donate, sign, volunteer
Wait a day to see how the story develops

questions.label: Friend is leaving
questions.prompt: A close friend is moving abroad for a year.

options.label: Throw them a big going-away party
Take them out for a quiet one-on-one dinner
Pledge weekly video calls and book a visit
Write them a long letter to open on the plane

archetypes.label: Bold
archetypes.tagline: You move first and figure it out as you go.
archetypes.blind-spot: Speed can mean someone else pays for a mistake that could've waited.

archetypes.label: Cautious
archetypes.tagline: You read the room, then move — and rarely regret it.
archetypes.blind-spot: Careful can shade into missing the window when the window is the point.

archetypes.label: Curious
archetypes.tagline: You'd rather understand before you decide.
archetypes.blind-spot: Research can become a way to avoid deciding at all.

archetypes.label: Compassionate
archetypes.tagline: You lead with the people in front of you.
archetypes.blind-spot: Caring can crowd out the harder, more strategic moves.
